verdict.rationale: The evidence hints at a first-party build pipeline: a 'Workers Builds' MCP server, events for 'a Worker build completing', and a claim that Workers fit into Git workflows. None of it says deploys are triggered automatically on each Git push, so support is glancing. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Git repo connection and push-triggered automatic deploys, branch or preview deploy behavior, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Fits into your existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code, and any framework.
